{{Quote|Get lost! I'm in a hurry!''"<br />"''I cannot get lost, sir. I'm a navigation droid.|Tahl and 2JTJ|<ref name="The Uncertain Path" />}}
'''2JTJ''', usually referred to as '''TooJay''', was a [[2JTJ personal navigation droid|navigation droid]] provided by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] to [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Tahl]] after she was blinded on [[Melida/Daan/Legends|Melida/Daan]].

2JTJ helped her with her new life, providing assistance so that she could start getting used to her new condition. However, the failed [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Xanatos]] installed an audio and video spying device inside the droid in order to track [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and Tahl's investigations. When they discovered the trick, they prepared a trap for Xanatos. In the end, 2JTJ continued serving Tahl.
